description: Sign this machine in as a SketchXFlow team member — no API key to paste. Returns a link and a short code: the developer opens the link in a browser where they are signed in to the staff console, checks the code matches and approves. Call it again (or any other tool) after approving. Already signed in? It says who as.
name: sketchxflow_dev_login
title: Sign in to the developer MCP
